everywhere.title: Everywhere
everywhere.mineHint: Tickets assigned to you in every workspace, newest activity first.
everywhere.mailHint: Your inboxes in every workspace with Collab, newest first.
everywhere.emptyMineHint: Tickets assigned to you in any workspace show up here.
everywhere.emptyMailHint: Conversations from your mail accounts in every workspace show up here.
everywhere.noMail: None of your workspaces has Collab
everywhere.noMailHint: All mail gathers the mail accounts of the workspaces that have it.
everywhere.more: Older ones are in each workspace's own list.

customize.title: Workspaces
customize.description: How the workspaces you belong to share the sidebar, the bell and the Everywhere lists. Only you see these settings.
customize.togetherHint: Every workspace in one sidebar and one bell, each marked with its badge.
customize.separateHint: One workspace at a time. Switch with the workspace menu.
customize.mixedHint: Inbox, teams, views and mail combined, each row marked with its workspace.
customize.everywhereHint: Assigned to me and All mail, across your workspaces.
customize.orderHint: Drag to reorder, or press Alt with the up or down arrow. A hidden workspace stays out of the sidebar, the bell and the Everywhere lists.
customize.itemsHint: Choose what each workspace shows in the sidebar.
customize.failed: Couldn't save. Your change was undone.
customize.singleHint: Once you join another, you can show them together here.
